name: blender-mcp
description: Blender Lab's official Blender MCP server, with a skill for safe scene work.

interface.shortDescription: Control and inspect Blender through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Connect to a running Blender instance through Blender Lab's official MCP server. Inspect scenes and data-blocks, search bundled Blender documentation, execute Python in Blender, navigate the interface, and render previews.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my open Blender scene and summarize its objects, materials, and cameras.
Create a simple scene in Blender and render a thumbnail.
Find performance outliers in my current Blender file.
